detail.rationale: Checkout is timing out (92% success, 4 timeouts in 15s per TEL-2) and 12 sessions are blocked by pid 12828 which has been idle in transaction for 4.0s (DB-1). An idle-in-transaction session holding locks for this long indicates a stuck or abandoned worker; terminating it will immediately release the locks and unblock the 12 waiting sessions, restoring checkout throughput.
